I farm a small plot here in the North West, and for my beans I must be careful with money and use what I can manage with my household. Since beans do not need much chemical fertilizer and cash is tight, I will rely more on a little manure, my own seed choice, and family work. I may use some chemical for weeds or pests if I can afford a small amount, but I will not irrigate because this is rainy-season farming.
